title: Fresh holdout: frozen 512-MiB maxPartitionBytes policy on never-tested query shapes
status: frozen before pilot and before any measured run
hypothesis: The frozen 512-MiB spark.sql.files.maxPartitionBytes candidate stays within 10% point-median regret of the per-query best size on 4 query shapes the original study never tested (multi-key aggregation, self-join, window top-N, wide selective filter). Secondary: same check for 2048 MiB; 128 MiB reported for context.

data.note: Epoch schemas conflict (names and types). Queries use per-epoch explicit select/cast adapters unioned by name; only columns type-consistent within each epoch are selected. PULocationID used only in the 2011-only query.

queries.q1_multikey_agg: Full corpus. groupBy(vendor, ptype, pcount) -> count, sum(fare_cents), sum(tip_cents), sum(total_cents), sum(dist_milli), min(dist_milli), max(total_cents); orderBy keys; collect.
queries.q2_selfjoin: Full corpus. dim = groupBy(vendor, ptype).agg(sum(total_cents) s, count c); join base back on (vendor, ptype); groupBy(vendor) -> count, count(total_cents*c > s), sum(fare_cents); orderBy vendor; collect.
queries.q3_window_topn: 2011 epoch only (176.9M rows; full-corpus window sort would blow the runtime budget; PULocationID exists only in 2011). Project 6 integer-ized cols; rank() over (partitionBy PULocationID orderBy total_cents desc, dist_milli desc, fare_cents desc) <= 3; groupBy(PULocationID) -> count, sum(total_cents), sum(dist_milli), max(tip_cents); orderBy PULocationID; collect.
queries.q4_wide_selective_filter: Full corpus, 10 projected columns. Filter trip_distance > 30.0 AND total > 200.0 (expected <1% survivors); global agg -> count, sums of 6 cent columns, min/max(dist_milli), max(total_cents), sum(pcount), countDistinct(vendor), countDistinct(ptype); collect (1 row).
queries.determinism: All hashed aggregates use long integers (cents = cast(round(x*100) as long), milli = cast(round(x*1000) as long)) so sums are order-independent; rank() (not row_number) with a 3-column ordering key makes the top-N row set partition-invariant. Result hash = sha256 over canonically sorted rows.

block_plan.sessions: one spark-submit session per block; local[8], --driver-memory 12g, RAPIDS plugin enabled
block_plan.warmup: one untimed pass of all 4 queries at 512 MiB at session start
block_plan.measured: all 16 (query,size) cells per session in seeded randomized order (random.Random(seed).shuffle)
block_plan.timing: time.monotonic around collect() of the small deterministic result; planning included in every cell identically
block_plan.per_cell_conf: spark.conf.set('spark.sql.files.maxPartitionBytes', size) before building the query; scan task counts from event logs must differ across sizes, else flag

pilot.purpose: one session, all 4 queries at 512 MiB only; validates correctness, hash stability, selectivity, and runtime budget. Excluded from analysis.
preregistered_fallbacks: If q3 exceeds 60 s in the pilot, shrink q3 input to 2011-01..2011-06 and note it.
If q4 survivor fraction exceeds 1%, tighten predicate to trip_distance > 50.0 AND total > 300.0.
Fallback decisions are made once, after the pilot, before any measured block.

exclusion_rules: A cell that errors is retried once within its session; a second failure leaves the cell missing and is reported.
If result hashes differ across sizes within a query, flag a correctness anomaly; that query's regret is reported but marked unreliable.
Any run > 120 s is kept but flagged; no mid-experiment redesign.
No measurements are discarded for being slow or fast; all individual measurements are reported.
analysis_plan: Per (query,size): median wall seconds across the 3 blocks; all 48 individual measurements reported.
Per query: best size = argmin of medians; regret(size) = median(size)/median(best) - 1 for 128, 512, 2048, 8192.
Primary criterion: regret(512) <= 10% for every query. Secondary: regret(2048) <= 10%.
Safety: sum gpuRetryCount, gpuSplitAndRetryCount, gpuSpillToHost/DiskBytes per cell from event logs; any nonzero value is flagged.
Scan-stage task counts per cell from event logs verify the partitioning treatment actually changed; identical counts between adjacent sizes are reported as treatment collapse.
Result hashes must be identical across sizes and blocks within each query.
budget: Total wall time under ~45 min: 1 pilot session + 3 block sessions.
limitations_declared_upfront: 3 blocks give no confidence bound; this is a descriptive point-median criterion.
Warm OS page cache; single host; local[8]; one GPU (RTX A6000).
q3 covers only the 2011 epoch and, with minPartitionNum=1 removed epoch bytes-per-core caps, large sizes may still collapse to few scan tasks.
Sums-of-cents queries are integer-heavy by design for determinism; string-heavy shapes are only partially covered via vendor/ptype keys.
